deposits_note: Deposits happen on the venue, signed in the user's own wallet; this site has no deposit path and never holds funds.
notice: Deposits are made on each vault's own venue, signed in your own wallet; Tnega never holds funds and takes no deposit. We describe each vault as its chain state and its operator's documents show it. Nothing here is advice.

statuses.listed: the platform was read this run and at least one vault qualifies
statuses.none_qualifying: the platform was read this run and no vault qualifies; `text` gives the reason
statuses.read_failed: this run's read of the platform failed (a fault in the call, not a fact about the vaults); earlier results, if any, are kept and marked stale

rule: Listed: vaults taking a stablecoin deposit (by mint address; USX and USDe are synthetic dollars and are labelled so). A listed vault lends that stablecoin on Solana; its borrowers' collateral is often crypto, so it is not a real-world-asset vault. It is listed when: Kamino and GLAM positions are read on chain, and Voltr positions are as recorded by the vault; nothing is placed with Drift; it does not lend into a market whose only collateral is one bespoke off-chain-backed token; the name is not a test, staging or demo name; and it holds at least 1,000 tokens. Amounts are counted at 1 USD per token (face value, not a market price).
checks: Stablecoin deposit, and what it is lent against

vaults.name: Allez USDC

vaults.audits: OtterSec, Sec3, Offside Labs, RX Security, Certora (platform's audit pages, read 2026-09-26)

vaults.lockup: No lock-up field; withdrawals limited by the vault's available liquidity
vaults.tvl_basis: token_available plus each cToken account's balance times its reserve's exchange rate, minus pending fees; USDC counted at 1 USD per token (face value, not a market price)
vaults.tvl_reconciliation: does not reconcile: cToken balance differs from the vault's record on 1 reserve(s); the vault's recorded AUM differs by +0.000% (within the 0.5% flag)
vaults.tvl_stale_rule: stale when last written more than 7 days before now
vaults.nesting_note: Part of this vault's funds sit in another listed vault; do not add the two TVLs together.
